row.notes: Scene manager = [[0x14601f5c8+0x28]+0x68]. Game_Scene_FindByName(mgr,p2,1); if found, builds a spawn-flags block (p7/p8 into it), transform from p4 (0x1401dbe20) + p3 position, and spawns an instance via 0x1401a4b70(mgr,flags,scene,xf,p5,..). If p6 adds the instance to list p1+0x18 (0x14018d980); if p8 calls 0x140190710(inst,1,0). Destroys the 0x28-byte entries of p5 (count p5[0x14]); returns instance or 0. Never spawns when not found: renamed from FindOrSpawn. (lane owner review requested) Better name: Game_FrontendScene_SpawnSceneByName (bound record keeps its name).
